articles.title: Old Bitly Links Hijacked to Redirect Users From McDonald’s, Burger King, and Government X Posts
articles.summary:
Old Bitly links embedded in historical X posts from McDonald’s, Burger King, government agencies, and prominent politicians have been repurposed to redirect visitors to unrelated websites. This incident highlights how trusted social media archives can become channels for redirection years after the original posts were published. This occurs even when the original messages remain unchanged, […]

articles.title: Hackers Use SEO Poisoning to Infect 1,000 WordPress Sites With Gootloader Malware
articles.summary:
Cybercriminals behind Gootloader have compromised more than 1,000 WordPress websites and operated 216 administrator-controlled domains. The supplied advisory links the operation to over $28 million in ransomware payments and describes sustained targeting of legal professionals through manipulated search results. SEO poisoning attracts potential victims; it is not the mechanism used to compromise the websites initially. […]

articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Exploit the ß vs ss Filename Trick to Bypass macOS Security Checks and Overwrite Files
articles.summary:

CERT/CC published Vulnerability Note VU#604762 on November 16, 2026. It describes a mismatch between the Apple File System (APFS) and the way multiple applications compare file paths.
